searchText: <@199561711278227457> how much luck do you have with running clients on minimal presets 😅 I've been trying to run with teku/nethermind & prysm/geth and it's like 50/50 on getting it stable each time , just been super flakey what bug do you see? they should all work - some might need special minimal images though oh it just starts with a bunch of missed blocks and sometimes stablizes itself vs other times it just keeps missing and never recovers not sure if you've seen this. maybe my scenario is special though , i've been testing a validator client from 0 active keys -> 10 active keys and fixing some really old bugs around that. in order to do it though i basically replace all the keys in one of the nodes with the inactive ones so from a network perspective at max there's only 75% partcipation to begin with could you add a genesis_delay to the mix? it seems like the network might just be starting too soon I was gonna start looking at it tomorrow actually can you paste your config you are testing?
